authorSeparation: Reviewer did not author PR #350 and does not implement current integration.

gates.finding: recognized() calls the original binding; exact sessionId/index/original task/node/type checks remain in each unchanged family.
submitted() calls latestSubmissionMatches and original replay, including original inspect(). Empty, stale or malformed attempts fail closed.
recognized requires bound.method===null; output method:null. New text disclaims free explanation, independent strategy and long-term mastery.
Presentation constructs strings and a new result object. Existing bindings/replays are called without editing the model or attempts.
Binding and submitted replay exceptions are caught; null proofs and unrecognized classifications return null.
Full-snapshot equality preserves existing saved-record semantics. It does not cryptographically certify that no historical action was omitted; the proposed text does not assert that.

P116.newClaim: The saved plot has recordCount integer records, modes and zero-frequency ticks derived from the existing replay.
P116.justification: Returned recordCount/modes/zeroFrequencyTicks are directly rendered; text does not credit the learner with computing an unasked mode, choosing the plotting strategy, or a free explanation. Both originals contain zero-frequency ticks, so the list is nonempty.

P109.newClaim: The current accepted expansion restores the two original terms, with greatestFactor coefficient and degree from existing replay.
P109.justification: Replay requires last accepted expansion to equal current inputs and original terms. Prior wrong expansions may remain, so naming the last expansion is clearer.
P109.suggestion: Replace 本次保存的展开与原式逐项一致 with 最后一次保存的展开与原式逐项一致.

P107.newClaim: The saved distinct unordered factor pairs multiply to the fixed original total; swapped orientations are counted once.
P107.justification: Rendering uses pairs.length and total from the existing complete canonical-pair result; it does not infer a general factor-pair algorithm.

P105.newClaim: The fixed original has checkedDivisors trial candidates, listed distinct factors and its neither/prime/composite classification.
P105.justification: The existing proof returns complete required candidates and factor set for 1, 2 or 51. New renderer has explicit names for all three classification values and rejects any other classification.

P091.newClaim: Only final endpoint/right direction/open-closed status and saved probe truth relative to the original inequality are described.
P091.justification: The historical graph positions/styles are not stored; limitation explicitly says they cannot be reconstructed. The replay checks each actual truth, while it may retain historical graph disagreement. No general historical graph correctness claim is supported.
P091.suggestion: Replace 次试数判断已经按本题的不等号核对 with 次试数的题意结果已经按本题的不等号核对. Never call all historical graph verdicts correct.

integrationRecommendations: Preserve independent human/formal mathematical approval as pending. This review supports isolated preparation and review; it is not an A grant or production release approval.
Use a multi-entry lookup by type and then the original binding/source key. The five-type Map in #350 is safe only for these five distinct types; all113 families have repeated widget types.

For shared-runtime integration, call candidate source selection before any existing type branch that returns null; otherwise new original positions sharing an existing widget type can remain unreachable.
Keep approved A813 manifest unchanged until its separate approval. Candidate integration and formal qualification need distinct fields.

Test changed dispatch/presentation/approval gates on the new HEAD; reuse original mathematical and browser evidence. Existing #350 presentation tests use one position per family and do not individually cover the neither/composite, x-factor and exclusive-endpoint text branches; cover those new rendering branches only if the same detailed renderer is retained.
